itemchecklist.screen.title: Item Checklist
itemchecklist.screen.empty: The list is empty. Switch to "Add items".
itemchecklist.screen.hint_add: Click an item to add it to the list.
itemchecklist.screen.hint_list: Type an amount or use the buttons, X removes the item.
itemchecklist.screen.drag_hint: Drag the list with the mouse to move it (yellow frame).
itemchecklist.import.title: Import list
itemchecklist.import.hint: Reads lines like "200 - Glass" from the clipboard.
itemchecklist.import.summary: %s lines found, %s matched. Click on the right to change the item.
itemchecklist.import.empty: No lines found. Copy the text and click "Re-read clipboard".
itemchecklist.lists.hint: In game, the arrow keys switch lists.
